author: Andrew Fisher

findings.source: Shared surfaced-vehicle fragment shader materials and reflectionWeight
findings.detail: Plant coatings and rubber/interior shared kind 3 and a 0.13 reflection multiplier. Explicit named-material semantics separate coating from tyre response.

Orange was forced to roughness 0.40, reflection multiplier 0.24 and clearcoat weight 0.08. Charcoal used clearcoat 0.36. New dielectric coat treats both as coated paint without metallic/chrome response.
Glass alpha was 0.84 to 0.96 with dark tint and weak front-on reflection. New response uses bounded Fresnel reflection and lower opacity with outward-face rejection.

Production race/plant sync already sorts opaque parts before glass and appends race decals. Earlier inference that race-cockpit draw order was defective was corrected after independent review. Trailer upload does not pre-sort; common explicit draw order makes that path consistent. CPU fixture is intentionally unsorted.
Existing shader lacked derivative normal-variance filtering. New roughness filter bounds subpixel highlights before stronger coat response.
Existing immutable 1024x512 R8 atlas used linear minification without mipmaps. New mip chain retains glyph bytes and texture count, adding 174763 bytes per context.

findings.source: G.renderSize, G.QUALITY, G.stepDown, GC3D canvas styles
findings.detail: No pixelated/crisp-edges canvas CSS found. Balanced requests two-sample MSAA, scale 1 and DPR cap 1.5. Adaptive guard can drop composite and scale to 50%. Guard remains unchanged. Original capture JSON lacked graphics/backbuffer measurements, so no claim is made that adaptation caused those stills.
